meta_title: Daniel John Landscapes | Garden Design Southampton
meta_description: Daniel John Landscapes in Southampton offers expert garden design, landscaping, and maintenance. Local family business serving Sholing and surrounding areas. Call today.
hero_subhead: Bespoke garden design and landscaping that turns neglected outdoor spaces into beautiful, usable gardens you'll love.
services_heading: Complete Garden Landscaping Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From initial design through to planting and hard landscaping, we handle every aspect of creating your dream outdoor space.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We'll draw up detailed plans and 3D visualisations so you know exactly what you're getting before we break ground.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Quality patios and decking that withstand the British weather. We source premium materials and build sturdy, level bases that last for years without movement.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert planting design that brings colour and structure year-round. We choose plants suited to your soil and sunlight, with low-maintenance options available.

services.title: Fencing & Screening
services.desc: Durable fencing and privacy screens installed to last. We handle everything from repairs to complete fence replacement, with a range of styles and heights.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Reliable weekly or monthly maintenance keeps your garden looking sharp. Grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal tidy-ups all handled by the same team.

services.title: Specialist Tree Work
services.desc: Safe tree felling, pruning, and stump removal. We're experienced in working on residential gardens and always leave the site tidy and safe.

about_pullquote: I build gardens people actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: Daniel John Landscapes was founded on a simple idea: every garden deserves to be beautiful, functional, and suited to the people who use it. Over 15 years, we've grown from a one-man operation into a trusted team, transforming more than 250 gardens across Southampton and beyond. We combine practical horticulture knowledge with honest, straightforward service—no jargon, no hidden costs.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen first, build second, and take pride in the details. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing a tired space, we work at your pace and budget. Most of our new business comes from referrals and repeat clients—a testament to the relationships we build along the way.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Daniel and his team completely transformed our overgrown back garden into somewhere we actually want to spend time. The design was spot on, and they kept the site clean every day. Brilliant service from start to finish.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a quote from another landscaper that was way over budget. Daniel came out, listened to what we actually wanted, and delivered a fantastic garden for a fair price. His team are friendly and professional. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: We've had Daniel back three times now—first for the full garden design, then fencing, and now monthly maintenance. He's reliable, shows up when he says he will, and the work quality is excellent. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: James W.
